definitions.explanation: Containing no artificial additives such as preservatives, colorings, or flavorings. Commonly seen on food and cosmetic labels.

examples.japanese: {無添加|むてんか}の{石鹸|せっけん}を{使|つか}う。
この{醤油|しょうゆ}は{無添加|むてんか}で{体|からだ}にいい。
examples.english: This soy sauce is additive-free and good for your health.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもには{無添加|むてんか}の{食品|しょくひん}を{食|た}べさせたいと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: I want to feed my children additive-free food.

notes:
Composed of {無|む} (without) + {添加|てんか} (addition/additive). A marketing and labeling term frequently seen on product packaging in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無添加|むてんか}{食品|しょくひん} — additive-free food
- {無添加|むてんか}{化粧品|けしょうひん} — additive-free cosmetics
- {無添加|むてんか}{石鹸|せっけん} — additive-free soap
- {無添加|むてんか}・{無着色|むちゃくしょく} — no additives, no artificial coloring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無農薬|むのうやく} — pesticide-free
- オーガニック — organic
- {天然|てんねん} — natural (often used for ingredients)
